purpose: Plausibility benchmark for the world and continental rankings (2.14). Each list names places that independent, widely documented evidence associates with the profile. It is NEVER used in a score; it only measures whether the model, built from public data, finds them on its own. A place counts as found when the best-ranked Nestlyzer place within 25 km of it (its metro area) is found.

biz_hq.why: Where the largest companies keep their head offices: the cities with the most Fortune Global 500 / Forbes Global 2000 headquarters and the regional-HQ hubs named by national investment agencies.

biz_tech.why: The software and technology clusters with the largest tech workforces and venture investment: Silicon Valley and San Francisco, Seattle, Boston, New York, London, Berlin, Paris, Stockholm, Tel Aviv, Bengaluru, Toronto, Singapore, Tokyo, Seoul, Zurich.

expat_professional.why: The cities with the largest internationally mobile professional workforces and international schools (foreign-born residents in high-skill jobs): London, New York, Singapore, Hong Kong, Dubai, Zurich, Geneva, Amsterdam, Munich, Luxembourg, Brussels, Toronto, Sydney, Tokyo.

student.why: Cities that recent editions of the QS Best Student Cities ranking place in their top 20, plus the classic university towns: London, Tokyo, Seoul, Munich, Melbourne, Paris, Sydney, Zurich, Berlin, Montreal, Boston, Vienna, Edinburgh, Toronto, Vancouver, Cambridge.

pensioner.why: The best-documented retirement destinations: the Algarve, the Costa del Sol and Costa Blanca, the Côte d'Azur, Florida's Gulf coast and Arizona, Cyprus, Malta.

remote.why: The cities that host the most remote workers and digital nomads and that run dedicated programmes for them: Lisbon, Porto, Barcelona, Valencia, Madrid, Las Palmas, Berlin, Tallinn, Split, Mexico City, Medellín, Buenos Aires, Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Kuala Lumpur, Dubai.

hnw.why: Where wealthy households settle, by the concentration of millionaires and of low-tax wealth hubs: Zug, Geneva, Lugano, Gstaad (Saanen), London's Kensington and Chelsea, New York, Miami and Palm Beach, Singapore, Hong Kong, Dubai, Monaco's neighbour the Côte d'Azur, Luxembourg.

sun_retiree.why: The best-documented retirement destinations: the Algarve, the Costa del Sol and Costa Blanca, the Côte d'Azur, Florida's Gulf coast and Arizona, Cyprus, Malta.
